meaning: True: the field is trusted only after a person confirms it, whatever its rule run says; placeholders are the document types and fields that declare trust settings.
Passed rules of the latest rule run an unconfirmed field needs before it is trusted; loosening needs extraction_mapping evidence.
Minimum OCR confidence, where the engine reports one, below which an OCR field is untrusted.

True: the approval of a matching rule version proposed by an LLM ends the LLM's contribution to its later matches, under the five conditions of ADR-0063 rule 8; llm_suggestion drafts never auto-post. Bounded false until ADR-0065, which lifts the bound under the author's decision of 2026-11-16; enabling it is a loosening by proposal.
Company-currency ceiling for the amount_max of a bank_charge rule that auto-posts; 0 disables the class. No other core value: an amount depends on the currency.
Lines a bank_charge rule needs, all posted unchanged to its account, before its auto-post may be enabled.
Statement months the evidence lines of a bank_charge rule must span.
The bank transaction codes this bank account's statements use for charges; a bank_charge rule passes the counterparty check only on a debit line with one of them. Empty: no line qualifies.

Error ceiling of acting auto-post paths in percent: evidence of a learned or probabilistic matching path needs N proposals with at least (1 - rate) posted unchanged, N >= 3 / rate; the default gives 300 at 99%. Never above 2%.
Longest evidence window a small company may use to reach a function's or kind's case minimums; a longer window, never a lower bar.
Backtest cases a parameter set version of the bank cascade needs; the lower bound is the declared small-company minimum.
Compared live cases in shadow or assisted a parameter set version of the bank cascade needs; the lower bound is the declared small-company minimum.
How a configurable claimable kind starts the agent: always (agent_wake_up, today's behavior), by_rule (only automation rules with start_agent), off (people only).
What agent_quality_below_threshold does beyond the signal: nothing, pause new runs, or run as shadow until promoted again (until Phase 2, demote_to_shadow acts as pause_new_runs; ADR-0078 rule 5).
Verified analysis examples from which the shadow evaluation is part of the analysis agent's promotion evidence and starts automatically.
True: below the minimum the synthetic CI report alone may promote the analysis agent, and answers say so.

Per data class: model processing, cross-border rule, assessment kind and deadline, allowed countries, maximum provider retention, no-training requirement and package-declared exemptions. No core default; packages may only tighten the core floors.
table.field paths the gateway strips from every request even where a permission covers them; it can only narrow.
What a tainted run reads beyond its scope rows: declared projections of closed shapes (default) or the literal scope only.
True: names of the company's own personal records in an analysis question are replaced by handles before any model call.
Whether the WebAssembly extension runtime may run; its bound is false while no runtime exists (Phase 1).
Instruction budget of one extension call at a point, within the point's ceiling; metering is always on.
Linear memory of one extension call at a point, within the point's ceiling.
Wall-clock deadline of one extension call at a point, within the point's ceiling.
True: the automation consumer acknowledges events without evaluating any rule; pausing is immediate, resuming a proposal.
Automation rule versions a company may have in force at once.
Days of recorded events the replay diff evaluates before an activation.
Events the replay window must hold before an activation; at 0 the diff is shown without a count gate.
Refused, failed or partial live executions within the window that disable a rule.
The breaker's counting window in minutes.
Refused, failed or partial live executions in a row that disable a rule at any rate; never below automation.breaker_failures.
The flood guard: live executions of one rule in a clock hour beyond which the consumer records rate_limited and acts no more that hour.
How a product gets its code: from the company's code series (gaps allowed), typed by a person, or either.
The prefix of a sequence code: none, or the category's short code when it has one; no rule reads meaning from it.
The N of {counter:N} in the code series format.
Longest unit name a statutory output accepts; unset in the core, meaning no limit; a longer name is refused, never cut.
Where a statutory output takes a core unit's name: the package's statutory name, else the core translation; or the translation only.
The unit code scheme of e-invoice lines: UN/ECE Recommendations 20 and 21, or none; another scheme maps through a package file.
Value of a purchase return: the document value or the current preliminary price; a regime rule with no core default, which a regime may open as a company option paired with the costing role.
Costing role of a purchase return: a negative receipt, or an issue revalued at period end; allowed pairs (document, receipt) and (preliminary_price, revalued_issue).
True: a return of a receipt with allocated landed cost carries its proportional share; an optional key with a core default.

Value of a sales return receipt: the document value (the original issue cost of the delivery line it names) or the current preliminary price; a regime rule with no core default, which a regime may open as a company option paired with the costing role.
Costing role of a sales return receipt: a receipt entering the period's receipts, or an issue revalued at period end; allowed pairs (document, receipt) and (preliminary_price, revalued_issue).
How analysis answers explain: key facts only, or a claim plan rendered by code; the installation value is the maximum. free_prose is outside the bounds in Phase 1.
Reading of day 00 in (12), (15), (16) and (17): the month's last day (GS1), its first day, or refused.
Reading of day 00 in (11) and (13): the month's first day (today's reading), its last day, or refused.
True: (15) best before fills a new lot's expiry date when (17) is absent; false stores it as best_before_date only.
An AI the parser does not map: reported as gs1_element_ignored, or the scan refused.
A suspected lost separator: the scan stops for confirmation, or a profile proven to send GS is trusted.
Days between issue dates within which a same-seller invoice is a near duplicate.
Gross amount difference in minor units within which a same-seller invoice is a near duplicate.
How invoice numbers compare in the near check: as typed, letters and digits case-folded, or digits only.
A near duplicate: advisory check result only, or review with payment held until a person resolves it.
off: people reserve; on_release: release reserves and the sweep fills shortfalls; scheduled: lines are reserved as they enter the window.
Days before a component line's requested date in which mode scheduled reserves it.
Days ahead whose orders the readiness run and the shortage item cover.
The candidate kinds the shortage resolution may offer; transfer_reservation, split_order and partial_staging are enabled by the company.
Days of lateness a production order's supply may have before an expedite message; 0 shows every lateness.
Days a production order's supply may be early before a postpone message.
Days ahead within which postpone messages are raised for production orders.
Share of both volume and weight below which the last container of a purchase group counts as underfilled and raises the exception container_underfilled.
Days ahead that a cancel message looks at when it asks whether a supply line is still needed; 0 uses the node's planning horizon.
Days after the planned start before an approved, not started order is start overdue.
Days after the planned end before an order that is not technically complete is overdue.
Working days without a posting after which an order in progress is stalled.
Share of G received at which an order whose operations are done becomes a completion candidate.
Allowed excess of cumulative yield and scrap over the previous operation's yield, or Q for the first.
warn gives yield_above_tolerance; reject refuses with yield_tolerance_exceeded.
Allowed excess of an actual activity over its standard before activity_above_standard.
Minutes within which equal confirmations of one operation are suspected duplicates; at least 10, so the check stays on.
The report sources the capture agent drafts from; photo needs the vision seat permission.
Lets the production import post clean confirmations as integration, also behind a policy rule enabled with evidence.
Import drafts the auto-post evidence needs; at least 3 / auto_post.max_error_rate (rule of three).
Share of those drafts people posted unchanged; at least 100 minus the error ceiling.
Calendar months the auto-post evidence spans.
Share of target cost at which an order's variance ranks.
Amount in company currency at which an order's variance ranks; 0 is off.
How many ranked orders the variance agent explains.
Whether persistent variance drivers raise standards review items.
Orders on which a driver must rank before a standards review item.
Consecutive periods in which a driver must rank before a standards review item.
Installation-wide agent cost per business date in USD, set at deployment by the operator and logged with the operator account; a raise needs a second operator account. No company cap may exceed it.

A company's agent cost per business date in USD. The installation value, set at deployment, is the maximum of every company's value; without one, the startup step records agents.installation_daily_max_cost as it. Lowering is immediate; raising is a proposal another person approves.
Share of the company's daily cap that only agent types reading no outside content may use (never tainted by design); agent types that read outside content share the remainder.

Cost in USD of one assistant run (ADR-0077), inside the company cap agents.company_daily_max_cost; it may only lower the cost ceiling of the assistant's declaration; lowering is immediate, raising is a proposal another person approves.

Minutes an external consumer waits after a call with an unknown outcome before it asks the provider for the status of our reference; a resend needs two status queries at least this far apart that both find nothing.
Unknown rounds after which the consumer stops, holds the delivery and raises a work item for a person; the document stays in issuing or sending.

Days a released attachment object stays in the store before the orphan sweep may delete it; never shorter than the database point-in-time-recovery window, so a database restore always finds its objects.
Items one bulk review may submit or approve together; each still runs as its own command with its own approval record.

The auto-post gateway for the document type: off, shadow (decisions recorded, nothing posted) or live (posts behind an enabled policy rule with evidence). Placeholders: the document types whose checker runs on the gateway job; Phase 1 purchase_invoice.
Company-currency maximum of a draft the gateway may auto-post; 0 means none. No other core value: an amount depends on the currency.
Document currencies besides the company currency that the gateway may auto-post; empty: the company currency only.
True: a draft with values an LLM read from outside content may pass the gateway for this document type, also behind auto_post.allow_tainted_drafts, an active agent type and verified values.
True: every amount and quantity a tainted draft's posting uses must be trusted or confirmed by a deterministic cross-check; false only by proposal, the bases are still recorded.
Company switch for auto-posting tainted drafts through the gateway (the author's decision of 2026-11-16); each document type also needs its own allow_tainted.
Window of one auto_post_unconfirmed item per policy rule, due at its end: the posting period (today's behavior), the ISO week or the business date. The period lock still waits for every confirmation.
Posted, unreversed purchase invoices of the supplier in the company that the gateway needs before it auto-posts the supplier's next invoice.
Largest difference between a line's net unit price per inventory unit and the GR/IR price of its positions that the gateway still auto-posts.
Largest excess of the invoiced net over the received net of an order line that the gateway still auto-posts.
True: every order line the invoice references is received in full before the gateway auto-posts it; false: the received net need only cover the invoiced net.

Whether the company uses a work case kind: off (no case), manual (people open cases), by_rule (also automation rules with open_work_case) or auto (also the raise of the kind's trigger work item). Placeholders: the kinds of work-case-kinds.csv. A case grants no right and relaxes no check.
Business days from opening to a case's due date; unset: the kind's registered due rule applies.
Home screen per role template: a user whose role assignments in force include a template mapped to case_list lands on the case list; everyone else on the work queue. Both stay reachable.

always: the Post button shows the plan panel before every execution (today's behavior). on_exceptions: for a person's single Post whose simulation returns no review reason (ADR-0067 rule 12), the client executes at once with expected_plan_hash and marks it is_review_skipped.

Company-currency amount of the policy input up to which on_exceptions may execute a post without showing the plan; 0 means every post is reviewed. No other core value: an amount depends on the currency.
Code of the active business unit that profit-and-loss lines take when no line, item, cost center, project, header or site gives one; unset: such lines stay without a unit.
True: a profit-and-loss line without a business unit after derivation is rejected with business_unit_missing; reversal and closing lines are exempt.

True lets manual journal entries (general_journal) post to receivable, payable and loan control accounts; false, the default, blocks them. Lines on inventory, gr_ir, cost_object and fixed_asset accounts are always blocked, whatever the value (ADR-0014 rule 10 note; author's delegation, 2026-11-19).

True: when every required result of a lot is confirmed and passed and its plan revision has is_auto_accept_allowed, quality drafts and submits an accepted decision as system; a person still approves unless the company has an allow rule for system at submit of inspection_lot. False: people decide every lot.
True: a person who recorded or confirmed a result in force of a lot cannot submit its usage decision (segregation_of_duties). False: the inspector may decide their own lot.
Starting a WO whose derived state is waiting (previous operation or components): warn returns the check result operation_waiting; reject refuses with operation_not_ready.
True: PauseOperation needs a stop reason (stop_reason_required), so every pause becomes a classified stop log for later OEE.
True: an estimate whose production version and site have no costing sheet gets the gap costing_sheet_missing and cannot be released. False: it is costed without surcharges, as before.
True: a missing reason of kind cancel is refused with reason_required. A document can be canceled without a reason; true makes Cancel<Type> require one.
True: a missing reason of kind reject is refused with reason_required. A rejection names a reason of kind reject beside its required comment; false lets the comment stand alone.
True: a missing reason of kind return is refused with reason_required. Every line of a return document names a reason of kind return; false makes it optional.

True: a missing reason of kind scrap is refused with reason_required. Every scrap line, and every production issue, confirmation or receipt with scrap, names a reason of kind scrap; false makes it optional.

True: a missing reason of kind count_difference is refused with reason_required. Every count key with a difference names a reason of kind count_difference; false makes it optional and a report shows the difference as unexplained.
True: a missing reason of kind block is refused with reason_required. A block names no reason unless set true (no consumer in Phase 1 yet).
True: a missing reason of kind other_receipt is refused with reason_required. Every other receipt line names a reason of kind other_receipt; false makes it optional.
True: a missing reason of kind other_issue is refused with reason_required. Every other issue line names a reason of kind other_issue; false makes it optional.
Value source of stock_count_shortage: Quantity missing at a count is valued at the preliminary price; a required regime setting with no core default (regime_configuration_missing).
Costing role of stock_count_shortage: a receipt (negative for a shortage) or an issue revalued at period end; a required regime setting with no core default.
Value source of stock_count_surplus: Quantity found in excess at a count is valued at the preliminary price; a required regime setting with no core default (regime_configuration_missing).
Costing role of stock_count_surplus: a receipt (negative for a shortage) or an issue revalued at period end; a required regime setting with no core default.

net: a shortage in one bin and a surplus of the same item and lot in another are netted per item, warehouse and lot, and the bins corrected by warehouse movements; gross: each bin posts its own difference. A required regime setting.
True: notifications are e-mailed by preference (rule 7); false: no notification e-mail leaves for the company, and pending ones are dropped.
The hour, in each recipient's time zone, at which the daily digest of unread notifications is e-mailed.
0: messages are kept; N: a daily job clears the bodies of messages older than N days and deletes their mentions and notifications. A lowered value takes effect 30 days after it is set.

Hours from the discovery of a personal data breach to the authority notification deadline; unset in the core, so no due date is set and the case says so. A package may supply the regime value; a company may set its own.
Days after which agent_run_step partitions are dropped; the agent_run row stays. A technical store: it may be shorter than a retention rule (ADR-0079 rule 9).
Days after which analysis question text and feedback notes are blanked; the installation value is the maximum, and a company may only lower it.

Years the bytes of an accounting-evidence attachment are kept after its last link ends; a legal period from the package, flagged verified or unverified; unset or unverified: the bytes are never purged.
Days after which outbox_event partitions are dropped, except a partition that still has pending, running or held deliveries.
Days an idempotency record is kept at least; a daily job deletes older rows. Not the audit log, which is never deleted.
